value.rationale: The same natural high-order nonsymmetric Laplacians have stronger ordinary Euclidean energy decay and A-stable implicit-step guarantees than positive real eigenvalues alone afford. The dimension-independent boundary energy certificate yields a practically interpretable stability conclusion, separates norm stability from maximum-principle positivity and diagonal symmetrization, and applies across all mesh sizes and Cartesian product grids. This structural stability theorem is not merely a restatement of the source spectral theorem.
